            raise Rejected()
        # Validate every pinned epoch before committing the child.  Live
        # contexts keep their images resident, so this is an invariant check;

        for ep in shared.hist:

                raise Rejected()
        child = Unit(c[0], c[1], c[2], parent.service,
                     mark=parent.mark, contexts=shared)
'''
